statement: The immutable 81 primary-sample token identities that occupied the broad boundary role in at least two original discovery genomes will predict boundary-role occupancy in the held-out species above a recoverability-conditioned random-boundary-label null.
support_condition: Observed T81 above null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above null mean but tail >0.05.
contamination_boundary: The P81 identity list and held-out species/assemblies are frozen before held-out sequence download/scan.
